_comment: Display numbers of problems whose stored number is not the printed question number (presentation overlay; the paper JSON is hash-bound to its receipt and is never edited). problems[problemId] -> the number the sidebar, the page title and the h1 show.

Mostly the one-question-per-file papers: each file was transcribed on its own and stores 'Задача 1' (IOAA 2021 tq-2 … tq-15, APhO/IPhO/ISPhO Q2 and Q3, the Всероссийская E2 experiments, IEPhO). Proposed by scripts/derive-question-numbers.mjs from paper.title, the paper id and the archive file name, and each one checked by hand against paper.title.

Where the title prints no number the archive file name decides (IEPhO '10_3_2017_problem' = grade 10, problem 3; '8_2_motion' = grade 8, day 2). IEPhO 2019 prints 'grade-problem' in the title ('Первый тур, 8-2'), which wins over its file name (8_1_woodpecker). The archive names IPhO 2023-2025 experiment files q4/q5; 2023 and 2025 print them 'Q1'/'Q2' (experiments are numbered apart from the theory), so 2024 q5 is Q2 as well.

A question the transcription split into parts gets '<question><printed part letter>' ('2A', '3B': APhO 2006/2007, IdPhO 2020 Q1, RMPh 2017 T2 parts) or '<question>.<part in order>' when the parts carry no printed letter ('1.3': IPhO 2007 T1, WoPhO; НОФ 2024 национален кръг 11-12 exp1, whose second 'problem' is the additional solution X of the sugar-polarisation task while sheet exp2 prints 'Задача 2'), so the question's parts sit together after its siblings instead of colliding with Задача 2 and 3.

IAO: a one-problem file stores 1 while its problem title prints the IAO number ('α-6. Наблюдатель кометы', 'β-8. Jupiter', 'αβ-7. …'); the printed number wins. Multi-problem IAO translations (bgtheo, bgpract) keep their sequential numbers.

Papers for different grades or age groups restart at 1 legitimately (IAO α/β, IEPhO grades, НОФ classes) and are told apart by the grade label: they are not renumbered. One file that holds every grade (BelPhO 1990-2003 and 2014, Всероссийская 2011 and 2022, ВсОА 1994-1998, 2023, 2024, СПбАО 2014, НОА 1998 IV кръг, ПУ 2006) stores its problems 1..N straight through while each title prints its grade-problem code: the code is the display number, in the form the paper prints it ('10-1' BelPhO) or the site's '<grade>.<n>' ('10.1', 'X–XII.1' as НОА 1999), and the title drops the repeated code. _unresolved lists what could not be settled; those problems keep their stored number.

SPbA 2011 grades 5–8 prints task numbers 1, 2, 3, 1. The final source number remains 1 in the transcription and is displayed as 1 (повтор) to distinguish the two real independent tasks without silently correcting the original.

_unresolved.nof-2018-iii-10-12-12-exp1: Experimental sheet 10-12_exp1 holds two unrelated tasks (a deflection magnetometer, the Hall effect) stored 1 and 2, while sheet 10-12_exp2 prints 'Задача 2' (surface tension). Which of them is the printed problem 2 cannot be told from the titles; both keep their stored numbers and the sidebar tells the sheets apart (round-labels.json suffixes).
_unresolved.iepho-2018-experiment-11-3-spectrum: Two grade-11 sheets carry archive file number 3 (11_3_slinky, the spring task grade 10 also sat, and 11_3_spectrum), and neither prints a problem number. Both are shown as problem 3 of grade 11, following the file names: slinky as 3, spectrum's four printed sections (1 Введение … 4 Спектр светодиода) as 3.1–3.4. Which sheet grade 11 actually sat as problem 3 cannot be told from the sheets. The spectrum sheet has its own sidebar node (round-labels.json suffixes), so its sections do not read as parts of the slinky problem.
